ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Userinit Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious child process of userinit

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\userinit\\\.exe$") AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\netlogon\\\\.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "explorer\.exe") OR process_path = "None")
